title: ECHS Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 36 Medical Officer, Dental Officer, Nursing Assistant and Other Posts
description: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 36 Medical Officers, Dental Officers, Nursing Assistants, Pharmacists, Safaiwalas, Data Entry Operators, and Other Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, MD/ MS, BDS, Diploma, DMLT, B.Sc, GNM, B. Pharm, 08th, 10th Pass, B.Sc Nursing can grab this chancea nd apply for the ECHS Notification 2026 .
